verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own Job Builder lets users generate and try out API requests through a graphical interface. The sandbox API lets those requests run without consuming credits, which covers the 'runnable' part of the story. However, nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive, for example per-endpoint try-it panels or runnable code samples embedded in the reference. Missing for 10: an interactive per-endpoint reference with runnable examples, a published OpenAPI or explorable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
